what: On hover it shrinks to .7x, swells to 1.11x, rebounds to .96x, then settles at full size, one jelly-like bounce (.8s). It restarts from the beginning on every hover. look: soft is for logos and bounces less (.76→1.08, 1.08s). look: pop makes dots and icons pop out from 0. look: settle has no shrink, pops to 1.1x, then halves down through 1.05, 1.025, 1.0125 and settles on a 2s overshooting curve (back-out), for hand-drawn circle buttons. look: squash squashes to 1.2 wide and .8 tall, tilts ±4° and wobbles for .98s on cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.35,1) before settling, and on release wobbles once more .92/1.08 → 1.05/.95 (.52s), for pill buttons and discs

options.target: data-fx-part name of the child to bounce, or the element itself if none
options.look: soft · pop · settle (Brand round button — 1.1 → halves each time, 2s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275)) · squash (Brand jelly button — squish and tilt .98s, wobble on release .52s)
options.area: Name of the child data-fx-part whose bounds are measured for the interaction (for a clip-path shape, it splashes only inside the shape), if none, the element itself
